description: Swedish official biogas statistics (SCB/Energimyndigheten; report produced by Energigas Sverige): produced biogas per plant category in GWh at the lower heating value (9.97 kWh/Nm³ CH4, report §5) and substrate input in kt wet weight (Tabell 3, 10, 11). Farm plants (gårdsanläggningar) report both quantities; 98 % of their substrate is manure of unknown species and form (slurry vs solid not split). Plants new in the year report part-year input and output alike.
source: Produktion och användning av biogas och rötrester år 2024 (ES 2025), Tabell 3, 10, 11 and the digestate table (farm plants 1 153 kt at 6 % DM)
